item.title: Wheeling health officials say wastewater testing high for COVID-19, RSV, FLU A, Norovirus
item.description: WHEELING, W.Va. (WTRF) - The Wheeling-Ohio County Health Department says recent wastewater tests show high levels of COVID-19, RSV, Influenza A (H3), Human Metapneumovirus and Norovirus in the community.
